description: Scripture retrieval test set. Each query lists the passage ids that answer it. Relevance was labelled by reading the passage text in src/data/scripture/passages.json (Phase 3, by Claude for the project owner). It has not yet been reviewed by a scholar; treat the numbers as a regression baseline, not a quality claim.
